title: Fix streaming chat EOF handling and wire context cancellation
author: Hiro Tanaka
description: Fixes a bug where the Go SDK streaming iterator could block indefinitely when the server closed the connection. Root causes: (1) scanner-based SSE read path ignored scanner.Err(), (2) context cancellation did not close the response body, leaving ReadString blocked. Changes: replace scanner with bufio.Reader loop that checks EOF and returns terminal errors; add a context-aware Close that interrupts reads; add tests with a fake server that closes mid-event.
